steps.content: You wake up in an endless sea, its boundaries nowhere in sight.
The water surface above you recedes, the moonlight tinged with a red glow devoured by the darkness below you, growing increasingly obscured.
There is no suffocation, no panic even—just an eternal descent. The frigid, murky water envelops you, numbing all sensation and emotion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The DisSea, the contamination source, the expedition...

A few fragmented words flicker through your foggy mind—they're your crucial mission here. Yet, you find your body out of your control, trapped in this everlasting descent like an insignificant grain of sand in the vast ocean.
After an unknowable time, you discern whispers emanating from the depths below.
Who could it be? Your targets—the members of the expedition? You can't be certain; those whispers are too distant and muffled to make out.
You try to turn toward the source of the sound, but your body remains beyond your control.
Gradually, that sound draws closer, carried into your ears by the seawater.
The currents shift, turning your body along, and at last you catch sight of the source of the whispers.
[Small CG 1 Section 1]
Instead of the familiar figures you expected, before you lies a vast, bottomless void.
Some soft, tentacle-like appendages reach out to drag your body down as the space around you slowly constricts. Above, the red glow becomes even more distant until it vanishes entirely.
Something's wrong—there's a presence in the void. You cannot descend any further. You must break free to search for your targets.
[Small CG 1 Section 2]
Your attempt proves futile. No matter how desperately you try to move, your body remains unresponsive. Then, it suddenly dawns on you that perhaps, a "corpse" is never meant to move.

You have been deceased—your limbs bloated and contorted in the sea water, your organs reduced to liquid. Carrion worms tunnel into your ears alongside the whispers, only to seep out through your eye sockets.
[Small CG 1 Section 3]
The whispers draw closer, growing more complex, while worms writhe and gnaw through your brain, devouring what little is left of your nerves.
Soon, you will fall into the utmost darkness, joining that presence in eternal demise.
At that moment, a wholly distinct voice—light but clear—pierces through the maddening whispers and resonates within your soul.
...Are you... afraid of this place?
Before you can answer, a hand reaches down and grabs you. Upon the touch, warm life-ness flows back into your body.

You find a mysterious being before you—neither fully human nor wholly otherworldly—enveloped in a faint white light, along with numerous ethereal white little creatures. Her true form remains veiled from your sight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not here...
...I see... Then... follow me...
Let me take you out...
Her voice envelops you in tranquility and solace, drowning out the fear instilled by the whispers from the previous darkness.
When you glance back, the tentacles that once ensnared you have already vanished without a trace.
